name: the Linux service restarts stall:watch 20 seconds after any exit, from its checkout under its PATH (#4167)
output:
[Unit]
Description=gandr stall detector (stall:watch)

[Service]
WorkingDirectory=/srv/gandr
Environment=PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
ExecStart=/usr/bin/mise run stall:watch
Restart=always
RestartSec=20

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

name: a host neither Linux nor macOS is refused a service (#4167)
#4866: the Linux unit carries git's configuration from the installing shell beside its PATH
output:
[Unit]
Description=gandr toolchain follower (toolchain:follow)

[Service]
WorkingDirectory=/srv/gandr
Environment=PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
Environment=GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/home/a&b/.config/git/config
Environment=CARGO_NET_GIT_FETCH_WITH_CLI=true
ExecStart=/usr/bin/mise run toolchain:follow
Restart=always
RestartSec=20

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

name: #6638: the Linux background service runs landing:watch at niceness 19, under the idle CPU policy and the idle IO class
output:
[Unit]
Description=gandr head watcher of landing (landing:watch)

[Service]
WorkingDirectory=/srv/gandr
Environment=PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
ExecStart=/usr/bin/mise run landing:watch
Restart=always
RestartSec=20
Nice=19
CPUSchedulingPolicy=idle
IOSchedulingClass=idle

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
